title: ChainedOptimizer.split_state_dict for single-chunk MoE only assigns to state_dicts[0], leaving all other sub-optimizers unaware of the model state and silently skipping their load
trigger_conditions: ChainedOptimizer with multiple sub-optimizers (e.g. dense + MoE)
root_cause: split_state_dict's single-model-chunk branch did state_dicts[0] = state_dict only, leaving state_dicts[1:] as None. Sub-optimizers beyond index 0 (e.g. the MoE expert optimizer) thus received None as their model state and silently skipped loading their parameters/optimizer states. The model proceeded with default-initialized expert parameters after a checkpoint resume.
invariant: After ChainedOptimizer.split_state_dict, every entry in state_dicts must be non-None when state_dict is provided and len(self.model_chunks) == 1.
diff_summary: Replace 'state_dicts[0] = state_dict' with 'state_dicts = [state_dict] * len(self.chained_optimizers)' in the single-chunk branch.
silent_check: Sub-optimizers gracefully accept state_dict=None and just keep their initialized parameters; no exception is raised at load time; training resumes but the MoE experts are not actually restored from the checkpoint.
